founder_approved_scope: Golden40 visual direction only; extracted PNGs remain candidates
pixel_treatment: Deliberate clusters; nearest-neighbor only; 4–6 useful tones per major material, no random dither
world_and_held: Separately authored when scheduled; never rotated icons

steel.reason: Distinct cool edge, broad dark blade, physical thickness

wood.reason: Directional warm grain with soft narrow edge light

canvas.reason: Coherent load, stitched pockets and diffuse folds; ignore white matte residue

plastic.reason: Dark molded housing, soft bevel and controlled display recess

paper_cardboard.reason: Folded carton planes; ignore reference text/trade dress and matte

food.reason: Natural organic volume, cap texture with localized shade

leather.reason: No independently verified full-leather Golden40 object; new calibration jacket proposed

glass.reason: No confirmed Golden40 glass exemplar; bottle material not established. Requires later calibration

rubber.reason: No isolated approved rubber standard; new boot soles proposed

candidate_normalization: nearest64_palette32_alpha128_v1; algorithmic cleanup, not hand-pixel approval
scale_gate: Founder acceptance of actual calibration exports; six inspected scores >=4, no critical defects; technical checks pass
